purpose: Partition the currently tracked repository into explicit semantic basins, distinguish source records from generated projections and intake, and assign provisional program ownership and authoritative entrypoint obligations without claiming semantic completeness or evidence truth.
matching_rule: longest normalized path prefix wins; unmatched paths enter unclassified-current-tree
ownership_rule: A basin owner is an accountable indexing program, not proof that every file in the basin has been correctly classified or adjudicated.

basins.label: Residual current-tree paths with exact Wave 01 dispositions
